root_cause.text: netvsc_copy_to_send_buf used phys_to_virt() on page buffer entries that may reference high memory pages (skb fragments on 32-bit x86 with CONFIG_HIGHMEM=y), which is invalid for non-direct-mapped pages, causing a kernel fault during memcpy.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states "on 32-bit x86 with CONFIG_HIGHMEM=y can live above the LOWMEM boundary. For such a page phys_to_virt() returns an address outside the direct map and the subsequent memcpy() faults". The patch replaces phys_to_virt() with kmap_local_page() to properly map high memory pages.
